proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_first_attack_of_turn
proposed_widenings.justification: The bonus transfer fires specifically on the first attack the wielder makes each turn with the weapon. This is not a passive, not on_caster_attack_hit (which fires on every hit), and not a once-per-turn activation cost (which would need 'free' activation cost not tied to an attack). It is a per-attack-sequence gate — fires at most once per turn, anchored to the attack action itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The first time you attack with the weapon on each of your turns, you can transfer some or all of the weapon's bonus to your Armor Class."

proposed_widenings.name: transfer_weapon_bonus
proposed_widenings.justification: The Defender allows the wielder to redistribute a bounded integer pool (the weapon's magic bonus, here +3) between two simultaneous effects: attack/damage rolls and AC. The split is player-chosen at the moment of the first attack each turn. No existing atom expresses this: modify_ac and modify_roll_numeric are fixed-delta atoms; there is no concept of a dynamic, mutually-constrained redistribution where reducing one bonus raises another by the same amount. The pool is the weapon's bonus magnitude, the split is a free integer in [0, N], and both halves expire at the start of the wielder's next turn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can transfer some or all of the weapon's bonus to your Armor Class. For example, you could reduce the bonus to your attack rolls and damage rolls to +1 and gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class. The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn"

proposed_widenings.name: RiderExpiry.wielder_turn_start (or caster_turn_start already covers this)
proposed_widenings.justification: The AC bonus from the transfer lasts 'until the start of your next turn' where 'your' is the wielder (not necessarily the caster in a spell sense). RiderExpiry already has caster_turn_start, which maps to this concept for weapon items where the attacker is the wielder. No new variant needed if caster_turn_start is reused. Noted for completeness.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn"

notes: The +3 weapon bonus encodes cleanly as a passive holding_item-gated pair of modify_roll_numeric (attack_roll) and modify_damage_numeric, matching the established quarterstaff_of_the_acrobat pattern. Typecheck passes; tracer emits a clean graph. The Bonus Transfer mechanic — the item's namesake defensive feature — is omitted from the authored JSON because it requires a 'first attack of my turn' trigger and a dynamic bonus-pool redistribution atom that do not exist in the current surface or v4 taxonomy. The partial encoding is honest about the omission.
